parsed.post: Discarding the 1.076 run; MATRIX_LR=0.11 was too high for DEPTH=6, leading to instability. Reverting to my best (1.059885). I'll try a more cautious approach: reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 while keeping DEPTH=6 and 5% warmup to see if more stable, slow convergence helps.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to stabilize training at DEPTH=6 and 5% warmup.
